picks.title: OpenAI files IPO paperwork
picks.why_it_matters: OpenAI's IPO filing signals a potential liquidity event that could reshape AI startup valuations and create new benchmarks for how the market prices frontier AI companies.

picks.title: Scoop: White House, Hill relaunch effort to block state AI laws
picks.why_it_matters: Federal preemption of state AI laws would dramatically simplify the regulatory landscape for AI startups, reducing compliance costs and removing a key barrier to scaling nationally.

picks.title: MiMo-v2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed: 1T model with 1000 tokens per second
picks.why_it_matters: A 1000 tokens/second inference speed at 1T parameters represents a step-change in cost-efficiency that could enable new categories of real-time AI applications and disrupt current inference-focused startups.
